name: world-literature-red
prompt: Create a finished peaceful watercolour illustration for a classroom website banner. Very wide panoramic composition, ideally 4:1 aspect ratio. All important subjects must sit within the central horizontal half so a 4:1 crop remains complete. Soft translucent washes on warm ivory cold-pressed paper, delicate expressive pencil details, quiet spacious landscape, elegant handmade art, no text, no lettering, no border, no logos. Small figures integrated naturally with landscape and foreground learning objects, not a collage of portraits. World Literature red section: gentle terracotta, muted rose, sage and gold. Don Quixote on a thin horse and Sancho Panza on a donkey travel peacefully past distant La Mancha windmills. On the other side the Monkey King with golden staff sits thoughtfully beneath a pine, looking toward an ancient Greek sailing ship far offshore. An old open book and feather quill rest on a foreground stone. Evoke journeys across cultures, humane wonder and literary imagination. All figures small and peaceful.
